title: Brand logos
blurb: Spot car and luxury brands from their badges and monograms, and know the story behind each.

groups.name: Car badges
groups.intro: What's on the bonnet, and what it means.

items.name: Ferrari
items.what: Black prancing horse on a yellow shield; the horse came from WWI pilot Francesco Baracca's plane.

items.name: Lamborghini
items.what: Golden charging bull on a black shield; founder Ferruccio Lamborghini was a Taurus, and models are named after fighting bulls.

items.name: Porsche
items.what: Crest with a black horse (Stuttgart's emblem), red-and-black stripes and antlers from Württemberg.

items.name: Mercedes-Benz
items.what: Three-pointed star in a circle, standing for land, sea and air.

items.name: BMW
items.what: Roundel quartered in blue and white, the colours of Bavaria (not a propeller, despite the legend).

items.name: Audi
items.what: Four interlocking rings for the four companies that merged into Auto Union.

items.name: Volkswagen
items.what: A V over a W in a circle; the name means 'people's car'.

items.name: Toyota
items.what: Three overlapping ovals forming a T.

items.name: Lexus
items.what: Stylised L inside an oval; Toyota's luxury brand.

items.name: Tesla
items.what: A stylised T shaped like a cross-section of an electric motor.

items.name: Rolls-Royce
items.what: Overlapping double R, and the Spirit of Ecstasy figurine on the bonnet.

items.name: Bentley
items.what: A winged B.

items.name: Aston Martin
items.what: The name across a pair of wings; James Bond's car.

items.name: Maserati
items.what: Trident taken from the Neptune fountain in Bologna.

items.name: Alfa Romeo
items.what: Red cross of Milan beside a serpent swallowing a man, the Visconti family emblem.

items.name: Jaguar
items.what: A leaping jaguar ('the leaper') or a growling jaguar face.

items.name: Subaru
items.what: Six stars of the Pleiades cluster, which is 'Subaru' in Japanese.

items.name: BYD
items.what: The letters BYD in an oval; the world's biggest electric-car maker, now everywhere in Hong Kong.

groups.name: Fashion & luxury monograms
groups.intro: Monograms and emblems you'll see on bags, belts and shop fronts.

items.name: Chanel
items.what: Two interlocking Cs, back to back.

items.name: Louis Vuitton
items.what: LV monogram on brown canvas with four-petal flowers and stars.

items.name: Gucci
items.what: Interlocking GG, plus the green-red-green web stripe.

items.name: Hermès
items.what: A horse-drawn Duc carriage, from its start as a harness maker; the orange box is iconic.

items.name: Dior
items.what: 'CD' initials and the Oblique monogram pattern.

items.name: Prada
items.what: Inverted triangle plaque on bags.

items.name: Fendi
items.what: FF 'Zucca' monogram designed by Karl Lagerfeld.

items.name: Versace
items.what: Medusa head inside a Greek key border.

items.name: Saint Laurent
items.what: Overlapping YSL 'Cassandre' monogram designed by A.M. Cassandre.

items.name: Celine
items.what: The Triomphe: two interlocked Cs, inspired by the chain around the Arc de Triomphe.

items.name: Givenchy
items.what: The 4G: four Gs arranged in a square.

items.name: Burberry
items.what: The beige-black-red check and the Equestrian Knight logo.

items.name: Tiffany & Co.
items.what: The robin's-egg 'Tiffany Blue' box with a white ribbon.

items.name: Cartier
items.what: Red boxes and the panther, the house's signature animal.

items.name: Rolex
items.what: A five-pointed golden crown.

items.name: Lacoste
items.what: A green crocodile, the nickname of tennis star René Lacoste.

items.name: Ralph Lauren
items.what: A polo player on horseback.

items.name: Nike
items.what: The Swoosh, designed in 1971 by student Carolyn Davidson for US$35.

items.name: Adidas
items.what: Three stripes, plus the trefoil (Originals) and the three-bar 'mountain' logo.

items.name: Supreme
items.what: White Futura letters in a red box.
